title: Biomass-derived 5-(tolylmethyl)furfural as a promising diesel additive: preparation, process scale-up, and engine studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27933-27940
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04020E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abhishek Kumar Yadav, Sandeep Kumar Yadav, G. N. Kumar, Vasudeva Madav, Saikat Dutta
5-(Tolylmethyl)furfural (TMF) was synthesized from carbohydrate-derived 5-(acetoxymethyl)furfural and petroleum-derived toluene. The physicochemical properties, engine performance, and emission analyses of TMF-diesel blends were studied.
